We resolve horizon problem (coordinated initialization), flatness problem (substrate self-regulation to Ω=1), monopole problem (no GUT phase transition—substrate is already discrete), and baryon asymmetry (Side A/B selection during boot). This establishes Big Bang cosmology as **computational initialization**, not physical explosion.
